reason: I already have a POS, a card terminal and a QR menu, and my guests here hand over a card or cash. A second QR for paying means my staff have to match those payments against the POS by hand, and I don't want that headache even if the first three months are free.
objection: Will my guests really pay by QR instead of handing a card to the waiter? If only a few do, I get no reviews and no guest list, and I've still added a system my staff have to learn, plus an extra transaction fee.
would_change_my_mind: If it connected straight to my existing POS so the QR payment closes the bill automatically, and I could see a restaurant like mine in Tbilisi where most guests actually pay this way.
